errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the countries and regions on the x-axis are listed in alphabetical order. They are actually sorted in descending order based on the value of the bars.

The description incorrectly lists the order of the categories on the x-axis. It swaps the positions of 'USA' and 'Vereinigtes Königreich'. The correct order shown in the chart is '...EU27, USA, Vereinigtes Königreich, Italien...'.
The description mentions that the OECD bar is purple, but fails to mention that the EU27 bar is also a distinct color (darker purple/red) and not blue like the majority of the other bars.
